evidence: Reviewed the full diff. The adapter validates its runner and project before starting the command, and relays stderr when the command fails.
decodeList refuses an absent or null memories array instead of reporting an empty project.
Split-part and scope-less rows are rejected only after the family filter, so unrelated rows cannot break the read.
The composition root and help line change consistently, and the new package is registered as an Adapter ring in the architecture test.
I found no defect this commit introduces that I could prove from the diff. The behavior of `memorycard list --topic-prefix` is outside the diff and cannot be verified here.
